payout_quote: you will be compensated for your participation (maximum of $446–$470 for completing all parts of the study).
steps: Open the CU Boulder Buff Bulletin posting for the RADD Lab stress study
Confirm eligibility: first-year student at CU Boulder
Contact the RADD Lab at raddlab@colorado.edu or complete the initial eligibility screening
Complete two in-person research sessions (4-6 hours each: computer games with heart-rate monitoring, interviews, surveys)
Complete three 21-day periods of daily micro surveys (<5 minutes each) via the study app
Receive up to $446-$470 for completing all parts of the study
catches: Pay is a maximum ($446-$470) for completing ALL parts across three semesters — not guaranteed or lump-sum
Long commitment: 3 semesters with daily app surveys for three 21-day stretches
Eligibility limited to first-year CU Boulder students
Study involves physiological monitoring (heart rate) and interviews about stress/mood
biggest_catch: Maximum $446-$470 requires completing everything across three semesters — two 4-6 hour lab sessions, 63 days of daily app surveys, and two 1-hour online surveys.
eligibility: First-year students at CU Boulder; screening survey determines eligibility.
timing: Three semesters; payment timing per part not stated on the posting.
